@@U03225@@
we regulate the cycles of sun and moon,
witness the supreme fate of nations,
see war and peace, drought and flood—
with calm passivity.

@@U03227@@
RIVER GOD 珀涅俄斯河 surrounded by TRIBUTARY RIVER GODS
and NYMPHS.

@@U03229@@
(Waking.)

@@U03230@@
Rustling rushes, stir, stir slowly!
Tangled sister reeds breathe lowly!
Willows waving, softly sighing,
To the aspens’ thrill replying,
Soothe my interrupted dream!
A dreadful premonition wakes me,
Some mysterious tremor shakes me
From my slumber-peaceful stream.

@@U03232@@
(Approaching the river's edge.)

@@U03233@@
Do my ears deceive me? Are there voices
behind these twining leaves and branches?
How human they sound.
The rippling waters chatter on,
and breezes titter away in jest.

@@U03235@@
(To 浮士德)

@@U03236@@
Come to our streams,
Here you'll find rest,
Here let your dreams
Answer your quest.
Here in the cool
Your limbs will be dressed,
By our soft rustling pool
We'll sing you to rest.
translation:
@@U03225@@
我们调节太阳和月亮的周期，
见证民族的最高命运，
看看战争与和平、干旱与洪水——
带着平静的被动。

@@U03227@@
RIVER GOD 珀涅俄斯河 被支流河神包围
和 NYMPHS。

@@U03229@@
（醒来。）

@@U03230@@
灯芯草沙沙作响，搅拌，慢慢搅拌！
纠结的芦苇姐姐低声呼吸！
杨柳摇曳，轻轻叹息，
白杨兴奋地回答道：
安抚我中断的梦吧！
一种可怕的预感唤醒了我
某种神秘的颤抖让我颤抖
来自我沉睡的宁静溪流。

@@U03232@@
（快到河边了。）

@@U03233@@
难道是我的耳朵欺骗了我？有没有声音
在这些缠绕的树叶和树枝后面？
他们听起来多么人性化。
水波潺潺，
微风嬉笑地走开。

@@U03235@@
（致浮士德）

@@U03236@@
来到我们的溪流，
在这里你会得到休息，
在这里让你的梦想
回答你的问题。
这里凉爽
你的四肢将会穿戴整齐，
在我们沙沙作响的轻柔泳池边
我们会唱歌让你休息。
